headline: Intel Stock Jumps On Report Google, NVIDIA Eye It As Backup Chipmaker
summary: Intel (INTC) stock sky-rockets 11.83% premarket to $110.90 following landmark reports that Google and NVIDIA are choosing Intel as a backup AI chip foundry.

headline: Tango Therapeutics, American Battery Technology, Intel And Other Big Stocks Moving Higher On Monday
summary: U.S. stocks higher, Nasdaq Composite up 1%. Tango Therapeutics (TNGX) shares up 34.1% on positive trial data. Other big gainers include ENHA, JLHL, ABAT, BTGO, GLXY, CLYM, SOC, SRAD, AIAI, ALOY, and GENI.

headline: 5 Stock Picks Last Week From Wall Street's Most Accurate Analysts
Nasdaq 100 Rallies Over 2% On Iran-Israel Ceasefire: Stock Market Today
summary: U.S. stocks bounced back from last week’s tech-led rout on Monday, as a halt to the semiconductor selloff and signs of de-escalation in the Middle East sparked a broad relief rally, with the Nasdaq 100 leading the way higher.
